  Profile summary  
 
Accomplished Treasury and Fund Accounting professional with over 12 years of expertise in Treasury Services, 
Global Cash Management, Fund Accounting, Securities Operations, and Payment Processing. Skilled in cash 
positioning, SWIFT MT/MX payments, FX settlements, reconciliations, operational risk management, and 
regulatory compliance across APAC, EMEA, and North America. Demonstrated success in leading cross-location 
teams, enhancing SLAs and reconciliation accuracy, strengthening internal controls, and driving operational 
efficiencies. Proficient in utilizing Bloomberg, Reuters, Oracle Flexcube, Aladdin, TLM, and Intellimatch to 
optimize financial processes and risk mitigation strategies.
